  <script>
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById("rcsymForm");
      const status = document.getElementById("rcsymStatus");
      const count = document.getElementById("rcsymCount");
      const title = document.getElementById("rcsymTitle");
      const text = document.getElementById("rcsymText");
      const advice = document.getElementById("rcsymAdvice");
      const emergencyBox = document.getElementById("rcsymEmergencyBox");

      if (!form) return;

      function selectedSymptoms() {
        return Array.from(form.querySelectorAll('input[name="symptom"]:checked')).map(function (input) {
          return {
            value: input.value,
            level: input.getAttribute("data-level"),
            label: input.closest("label").querySelector("strong").textContent
          };
        });
      }

      function updateResult(event) {
        if (event) event.preventDefault();

        const selected = selectedSymptoms();
        const hasEmergency = selected.some(function (item) { return item.level === "emergency"; });
        const hasSoon = selected.some(function (item) { return item.level === "soon"; });
        const hasMonitor = selected.some(function (item) { return item.level === "monitor"; });

        count.textContent = selected.length === 0 ? "No symptoms selected" : selected.length + " selected";

        if (selected.length === 0) {
          status.className = "rcsym-status";
          status.textContent = "Ready to check";
          title.textContent = "Select symptoms to get urgency guidance.";
          text.textContent = "The checker will suggest whether you should contact a rabbit-savvy vet urgently, call for same-day advice or monitor closely.";
          emergencyBox.style.display = "block";
          advice.innerHTML = '<li><strong>Reminder:</strong> This checker does not diagnose illness.</li><li><strong>Vet advice:</strong> Call your vet if you are worried or unsure.</li>';
          return;
        }

        if (hasEmergency) {
          status.className = "rcsym-status emergency";
          status.textContent = "Urgent vet advice";
          title.textContent = "Contact a rabbit-savvy vet urgently.";
          text.textContent = "One or more selected symptoms can be serious in rabbits. Do not wait to see if it improves, especially if your rabbit is not eating, not pooing, bloated, struggling to breathe, collapsed or showing flystrike signs.";
          emergencyBox.style.display = "block";
          advice.innerHTML =
            '<li><strong>Call now:</strong> Explain the symptoms, when they started and whether your rabbit is eating and passing droppings.</li>' +
            '<li><strong>Do not guess treatment:</strong> Avoid medicines, force-feeding or home remedies unless a vet advises them.</li>' +
            '<li><strong>Prepare safely:</strong> Keep your rabbit calm, secure and at a comfortable temperature while arranging care.</li>' +
            '<li><strong>Selected symptoms:</strong> ' + selected.map(function (item) { return item.label; }).join(", ") + '.</li>';
          return;
        }

        if (hasSoon) {
          status.className = "rcsym-status soon";
          status.textContent = "Call for advice";
          title.textContent = "Call a rabbit-savvy vet for advice today.";
          text.textContent = "The selected symptoms may need veterinary attention, especially if they are new, worsening or linked with reduced appetite, fewer droppings or pain signs.";
          emergencyBox.style.display = "none";
          advice.innerHTML =
            '<li><strong>Call today:</strong> Ask your vet whether your rabbit should be examined.</li>' +
            '<li><strong>Monitor closely:</strong> Keep checking appetite, droppings, behaviour and movement.</li>' +
            '<li><strong>Escalate quickly:</strong> If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, becomes weak or seems in pain, treat it as urgent.</li>' +
            '<li><strong>Selected symptoms:</strong> ' + selected.map(function (item) { return item.label; }).join(", ") + '.</li>';
          return;
        }

        if (hasMonitor) {
          status.className = "rcsym-status monitor";
          status.textContent = "Monitor closely";
          title.textContent = "Monitor closely and call if it continues.";
          text.textContent = "A mild change may not always be an emergency if your rabbit is still eating, pooing and behaving mostly normally, but rabbits can hide illness.";
          emergencyBox.style.display = "none";
          advice.innerHTML =
            '<li><strong>Watch appetite:</strong> Check that your rabbit is eating hay and normal food.</li>' +
            '<li><strong>Check droppings:</strong> Look for normal quantity and size of poos.</li>' +
            '<li><strong>Trust your instincts:</strong> Call your vet if the change continues, worsens or feels unusual.</li>';
        }
      }

      form.addEventListener("submit", updateResult);
      form.addEventListener("change", updateResult);
      updateResult();
    })();
  </script>
